description: MainActivity.java defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, managing fragment transactions and user interactions with fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages fragments for displaying news articles and handles user selection events.

methods.description: Handles user selection of an article, updating the article fragment or replacing it depending on layout.
